integrity: The theorem is proved analytically. The bundled numerical checker only stress-tests the Hermite majorant, zero-sum inequality, special-exponent algebra, and explicit cyclic extremizers; no finite computation is used to infer the continuum result.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers finite real exponents strictly greater than four. The sub-four regime is outside scope, and the complete equality statement is not asserted at the fourth-moment boundary. An older equivalent zero-sum-hyperplane formulation under different terminology remains a residual indexing risk.
title: All higher-moment constants for finite subgroup-hole spectra
